query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

env:
  NODE_VERSION: '22'

# Pushing often produces many concurrent runs; cancel superseded ones so CI
# minutes are not spent on stale commits.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  lint-test:
    name: Lint & Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: yarn

      - name: Enable Corepack
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack prepare yarn@1.22.22 --activate

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Lint
        run: yarn lint

      - name: Typecheck
        run: yarn typecheck

      - name: Unit tests
        run: yarn test

  rust:
    name: Rust Checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          SUDO=""
          if command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]; then
            SUDO="sudo"
          fi
          $SUDO apt-get update
          $SUDO apt-get install -y \
            libgtk-3-dev \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libasound2-dev \
            patchelf

      - name: Rust cache
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: src-tauri -> target

      # Type-check the whole crate (lib, bin, and tests) without codegen/link.
      # Catches the same compile errors as `cargo test` at a fraction of the cost.
      - name: Run Rust checks
        run: cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets

      - name: Run Rust unit tests
        run: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --lib

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
